setting: Haulage yard off the M62, West Yorkshire, 3 a.m., rain. We are in the transport office: the base radio is on Mick's desk.

MICK.name: Paul - Deep & Warm - Yorkshire
MICK.note: user's pick of five (24 Nov). Night planner, 50s. In the office with us (room voice) until he leaves.

ASH.name: Ashley - Bright, Yorkshire
ASH.note: user's pick of five; the gate man, renamed Ash (was Dave). Always on the radio.

STEVE.name: Tony - Middle-aged, Northern
STEVE.note: the Mick option not taken; only ever faint, behind the gatehouse glass, under Ash's open radio.

lines.text: Last one's in, Mick. Barrier's down.
Champion. Right, Steve's handover. OEU has an AdBlue fault, for a change. Wakefield's moved to half five.
lines.say: Champion. Right, Steve's handover. O. E. U. has an AdBlue fault, for a change. Wakefield's moved to half five.

lines.text: And... "Don't let anyone in after three. Not even me." Underlined twice.
lines.say: And... [reading slowly] Don't let anyone in after three. [puzzled] Not even me. [chuckles] Underlined twice.

lines.text: He's on a wind-up.
Daft sod's left his phone an' all.
Three o'clock. Gate's locked. All quiet.
Nobody in after three, Ash.
Not even Steve.
Mick. Steve's at the gate.
You what?
He's on foot. Says he's left his phone.
He has. It's here on my desk.
So I'll let him in, then.
Read the note, Ash.
Oh, give over. He's wet through.
Where's his car?
... He's walked.
From Holmfirth? That's twenty mile.
He'll not look up at the camera. He just keeps asking for you.
Is he coming down? ... Please.
Steve's never said please in his life.
Mick, I'm not leaving him out there.
Don't you open that gate. I'm coming down.
Ash. Keep him talking.
Mick... he's gone. Soon as you came out, he walked off along the fence.
Which way?
Yours.
Mick. I've found my phone.
lines.note: in the office with us, into Mick's base radio: the first time Steve is clear

notes.ending: After r27, rain on the office window; then the base radio's button clicks in the room and Steve, close and clear, says the last line; cut.
notes.delivery: eleven_v3 with tags (user: v2 read the key lines monotonously); three takes per character, each line chosen by accent check, then range.
